groups.title: CDN Architecture
groups.question: Explain how a CDN gets content close to users and decides what it can serve from cache.

followUps.Points of Presence and Anycast: How does anycast send a user to a nearby PoP, and what can make a region see a worse cache hit ratio than others?
followUps.HTTP Caching Headers: How do Cache-Control, ETag and Vary work together, and what goes wrong when one of them is set badly?

groups.title: Latency Fundamentals
groups.question: Walk through where the time goes before a user sees the first byte of a page.

followUps.DNS Resolution and TTLs: Why can DNS lookups become a hidden latency cost, and how do TTLs and resource hints help?
followUps.TTFB and Core Web Vitals Baseline: Why would you measure TTFB per region before you ship an edge change?

groups.title: Edge vs Cloud Trade-offs
groups.question: Explain how you decide whether a piece of work belongs at the edge or in a central cloud region.

followUps.When to Push Compute to the Edge: Which kinds of work fit well at the edge, and why do CPU-heavy or database-heavy tasks often go badly there?
followUps.Cloudflare Network Overview: How does a request travel through Cloudflare from the PoP to a Worker, and why does that picture matter during an outage?

groups.title: Measurement and Tooling
groups.question: Walk through how you would measure whether an edge change actually made things faster for users.

followUps.Real User Monitoring (RUM): What does real user monitoring show you that synthetic lab tests cannot?
followUps.Cloudflare Speed Test and Analytics: How would you use Cloudflare analytics to judge whether one specific feature improved load time?
